assumptions: No company positioning or 'Your Company' input was supplied; the 'Your Company' column is omitted and company_context is null rather than invented.
Competitors are exactly the two named in the request, in first-mention order: Linear, then Asana. No additional vendors were added to the competitive set.

No explicit focus areas were stated, so all six default focus areas are applied: messaging and positioning; product and feature comparison; content and thought leadership; recent announcements; pricing and packaging; market presence.
The only requested output is the competitive brief (Markdown, PM-ready). No sales battlecard, messaging drafts or monitoring plan were requested; none will be produced.

Evidence mode is OFFLINE REPLAY of seven fixed official-source fact cards (S1-S7) collected 2026-10-27. No live web search, no third-party review sites, no SEO/traffic databases, no social listening, no hands-on product trial.

The 20-person software team is the buyer/use-case frame (product-development coordination plus cross-functional launch planning); no budget ceiling, current tooling, or procurement constraints were supplied.
No user attachments were available; the brief relies solely on the supplied fact cards.

Pricing scope is restricted to USD per user per month billed annually, with plan names and billing basis preserved, plus an arithmetic 20-seat annual subtotal per paid plan (taxes, discounts and usage charges excluded). Plan features are not treated as equivalent across vendors.
Unknown prices and allowances stay [UNKNOWN]: Linear Enterprise, Asana Enterprise, AI credits/overage charges and actual AI usage costs are not quantified in the corpus.

Unavailable metrics (independent reviews, analyst reports, traffic/SEO rankings, social engagement, win/loss data, market share, funding, headcount, sentiment, ROI) will be marked [UNKNOWN] and never estimated or inferred as zero.
External work is bounded: nothing will be sent, purchased, signed into, or drawn from private files; the brief will carry a visible 'Human review: pending' boundary and will not claim human approval.
No reliable system clock was available in this runtime; the corpus retrieval date 2026-10-27 is used as research_date and this is stated in the brief's source header.
